name: Veined Fist
description: Strike with a fist of rock threaded with hard mineral veins that bite where they land.

name: Veined Guard
description: Lift a forearm plate of veined rock that rings dully against a blade and does not crack.

name: Seam Step
description: Step along a hard seam in the ground and push off it for a quick even stride.

name: Lodestone Press
description: Press a dense stone fist into the foe's chest so the weight lands in one point.

name: Vein Lance
description: Draw a long lance of mineral rock out of the ground and drive it through the target.

name: Tempered Slab
description: Harden a slab of earth by repeated pressing until it rings and turns a heavy blow.

name: Mineral Edge
description: Grow a fine edge along the stone fist and cut through shields and plated armor in one stroke.

name: Forged Bedrock
description: Harden the stone beneath into a dense floor that holds the stance and strengthens each strike.

name: Ironstone Hammer
description: Gather dense stone through the qi field into a hammer as heavy as a boulder and bring it down.

name: Forged Monolith
description: streams: Earth + Metal; draw metal into the rising stone until a whole mountain face hardens and falls as one forged mass.

name: Silt Palm
description: Strike with a palm sheathed in thick wet silt that smothers the blow and the wound.

name: Mire Guard
description: Hold up a sagging screen of wet clay that swallows a spear tip or arrow.

name: Clay Slide
description: Slide across slick wet clay on one foot with the other ready to plant.

name: Runoff Fist
description: Drive a fist trailing a runnel of muddy water into the foe's flank.

name: Mud Surge
description: Heave a thick surge of mud across the ground to knock down and drag back those before it.

name: Silt Snare
description: Raise a loop of damp silt about the foe's feet and tighten it as it dries.

name: Torrent Slab
description: Stand a slab of packed earth against a flood or a rush so both break against it.

name: Clay Tide
description: Roll a slow tide of clay round the foes that thickens as they struggle in it.

name: Silt Deluge
description: Pour a deluge of loaded silt over a broad front until nothing in it can stand.

name: Rooted Current
description: Send a slow current down through the stance so it roots deeper and shrugs off each blow.

name: Drowned Stone
description: Soak a wide stretch of ground through the qi field until it sinks and traps all upon it.

name: Torrent Strata
description: streams: Earth + Water; loose the water stream through every layer of rock so the strata heave and pour as a flood of stone.

name: Baked Palm
description: Strike with a palm of dry hot clay that hardens on contact and bruises deep.

name: Fired Guard
description: Fire the clay about the forearms to a hard crust that turns cuts and stings the striker.

name: Cinder Step
description: Step on a patch of warm cinder-dry earth that cracks and flings the foot onward.

name: Warm Stone
description: Heat the rock beneath the feet until it glows dull and lends its strength to the stance.

name: Scorched Spike
description: Raise a blackened spike of fired rock from the ground and drive it into the foe.

name: Baked Shell
description: Wrap the body in a shell of hardened clay that sheds blows and heat alike.

name: Ember Cobble
description: Throw a glowing cobble that bursts into hot grit where it strikes.

name: Kiln Crack
description: Bake the ground under the foe until it cracks and gives way beneath the lead foot.

name: Glowing Quake
description: Shake the ground with a heated pulse that cracks it and sears all who stand on it.

name: Kiln Press
description: Press the foe between two slabs of hot stone and hold them there while the slabs bake hard.

name: Cinder Burst
description: Burst a bed of baked earth outward in a ring of hot stinging shards.

name: Searing Slab
description: Heat a great slab until it glows and bring it flat onto the foe in the qi field.

name: Burning Bedrock
description: streams: Earth + Fire; set the bedrock itself alight so the ground glows and splits and the burning stone rises over the foes.

name: Grounded Fist
description: Strike with a fist rooted so firmly in the earth that its blow carries into the foe without loss.

name: Static Guard
description: Hold a packed stone guard whose surface prickles and numbs the arm that strikes it.

name: Flint Pace
description: Kick off a flint-hard patch of ground so a spark leaps and the body follows quickly.

name: Earthing Pulse
description: Send a pulse into the ground and read how it returns to find charged or hollow places.

name: Grounding Spike
description: Drive a stone spike through the ground that gathers charge as it rises to the target.

name: Charged Slab
description: Raise a slab that tingles with held charge and shocks a hand that touches it.

name: Arc Quake
description: Stamp so a crackling shake runs outward along the ground and stings every foot upon it.

name: Crackling Stone
description: Throw a stone alive with small sparks that jumps to a second target on landing.

name: Bolt Anchor
description: Plant a stone anchor that draws a bolt down into it and flings the bolt back at the sender.

name: Seismic Arc
description: Arc a shock through the ground in a wide curve that jars the muscles of those it crosses.

name: Thunder Stamp
description: Stamp so a deafening crack travels along the ground and stuns the foes nearest to it.

name: Anchored Bolt
description: Root a great bolt in stone through the qi field and spear it down into one target.

name: Bolt Descent
description: streams: Earth + Lightning; pull a lightning bolt down through the earth stream and root it in the foe's ground.

name: Rooted Thunderfall
description: streams: Earth + Lightning; drop a mass of charged stone from the sky so the lightning flows through the ground in every direction.
